description: This bar chart illustrates a runtime comparison of models in a streaming environment. The horizontal axis displays the categories: “Our joint Framework”, “ChatGPT”, “DeepSeek”, “LLaMA”, and “Claude”, listed in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Runtime (seconds)”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400, with tick labels at intervals of 50. Two sets of bars are presented for each category: a dark green bar representing “Our joint Framework” and a light blue bar representing “LLM Models”. For “Our joint Framework”, the bar height is approximately 77 seconds. The “LLM Models” bars have heights of approximately 190 seconds for “ChatGPT”, 365 seconds for “DeepSeek”, 172 seconds for “LLaMA”, and a value not explicitly labeled but visually around 290 seconds for “Claude”. The bars are arranged side-by-side for each category, allowing for a visual comparison of the runtime for each model type within that category. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
